title: Inspect the estimation result exports
description: You follow current variables into a JSON summary and bootstrap archive.

steps.description: You create artifacts and begin a summary dictionary. Numeric conversions prepare current parameter values for JSON.
You add Poisson, exponential, Gaussian, and Cauchy entries. Each field reads the variable bound to its name when this block executes.

steps.question: Do the Poisson and exponential entries read different lambda variables?
steps.answer: Both entries read lam_true and lam_hat. This block supplies the same current lambda values to both labels.

steps.description: You write mle_summary.json and save thetas in cauchy_bootstrap_thetas.npz. The recorded directory listing contains those two files.
